Custom or invented

Custom / inventedReason
Step indicator (dots + 'n of 3' label)Compass has no stepper/pagination-dots component; built from plain buttons and spans
Carousel container / card shellCCarousel is not recreated in the bound design system; single-step state machine built instead
Illustration areaNo illustration set in Compass; uses Compass line icons (pin-on-map, calendar-check, tickets) on a surface-secondary tile

Deviations from Compass

What deviatedWhyConfidence
Dot sizes (8px / 24px pill), 44px hit-area wrappers, 112px icon size, card padding and some gaps use hard-coded pxNo matching spacing or size tokens usedunsure
Illustration icons render in their default dark color, not the interactive-primary blueThe CSS-mask recolor approach failed (CORS on the serve origin); <img> ignores currentColoraware
Marketing-style copy ('Your next adventure starts here', etc.)User asked for more eye-catching copy; Compass voice is plain and factualaware
Icons copied into local assets/icons/ instead of loaded through CIconThe CIcon component resolved to a path that doesn't exist in this projectaware
Skip is a CButton text variant, which renders underlinedUsed the component as-isunsure

Coverage

Scenarios considered

  • mobile-width card (max 390px)
  • last step hides Skip and relabels Next
  • tap target size (44px for dots and Skip)
  • screen reader labelling (region, group, aria-current, aria-live)
  • text wrapping (balance/pretty)

Explicitly skipped

  • RTL / localization and long strings
  • reduced-motion (dot width transition is not gated)
  • swipe gestures
  • desktop / tablet breakpoints
  • dark theme
  • persisting completion state
  • real illustration artwork (icons used as placeholder)

Accessibility

CheckResult
Contrastnot checked
Keyboard navigationnot checked

Container has role=region and aria-roledescription=carousel. Dots are buttons with aria-label 'Go to step N' and aria-current=step. The dots group is labelled 'Step N of 3'. Text block uses aria-live=polite. Illustration is aria-hidden. Contrast and keyboard behaviour were not explicitly measured; only token-based colors were used. Next/Get started hold keyboard focus via the native button.

Artifacts

  • Onboarding Carousel.dc.html
  • assets/icons/pin-on-map.svg
  • assets/icons/calendar-check.svg
  • assets/icons/tickets.svg
